cd /home/mosure/repos/burn_quantum
export PATH=/home/mosure/.rustup/toolchains/1.95.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin:$PATH
export CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true
qualify_configuration() {
    local qualification_config="$1"
    qualification_backend="${qualification_config%-fusion}"
    qualification_args=("$qualification_backend")
    if [[ "$qualification_config" == *-fusion ]]; then qualification_args+=(--fusion); fi
    qualification_start="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
    if bash scripts/validate_backend.sh "${qualification_args[@]}" > "artifacts/photonic-completion/$qualification_config-run.log" 2>&1; then
        qualification_status=0
    else
        qualification_status=$?
    fi
    python3 - "$qualification_config" "$qualification_status" "$qualification_start" <<'PY'
import json,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
path=Path(f'artifacts/photonic-completion/{sys.argv[1]}-status.json')
record={}
record[sys.argv[1]]={'exit_code':int(sys.argv[2]),'started_utc':sys.argv[3],
                     'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(sys.argv[1],record[sys.argv[1]])
PY
    if [[ "$qualification_status" -ne 0 ]]; then
        tail -n 45 "artifacts/photonic-completion/$qualification_config-run.log"
        exit "$qualification_status"
    fi
}
qualification_pids=()
for qualification_config in wgpu wgpu-fusion cuda cuda-fusion; do
    qualify_configuration "$qualification_config" &
    qualification_pids+=("$!")
done
qualification_failed=0
for qualification_pid in "${qualification_pids[@]}"; do
    wait "$qualification_pid" || qualification_failed=1
done
exit "$qualification_failed"

"""Wait for completed, fresh configurations, then run the public comparison."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

os.environ["PATH"] = "/home/mosure/.rustup/toolchains/1.95.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin" + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("PATH", "")
os.environ["CARGO_NET_OFFLINE"] = "true"
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out = root / "artifacts/photonic-completion"
configs = ("wgpu", "wgpu-fusion", "cuda", "cuda-fusion")
names = sorted(p.stem for p in (root / "crates/burn_quantum_example/src/bin").glob("*.rs"))
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5400
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    ready = True
    for config in configs:
        path = out / ("cuda-fusion-final-status.json" if config == "cuda-fusion" else f"{config}-status.json")
        if not path.exists():
            ready = False
            break
        status = json.loads(path.read_text())
        if config != "cuda-fusion":
            status = status[config]
        if status["exit_code"]:
            raise SystemExit(f"configuration failed: {config}")
        core_status = out / "core-final" / f"{config}-status.json"
        if not core_status.exists() or json.loads(core_status.read_text())["exit_code"]:
            ready = False
            break
    cutoff = max(p.stat().st_mtime_ns for p in (root / "crates").rglob("*.rs"))
    if ready:
        for config in ("cpu", *configs):
            for name in names:
                path = root / f"artifacts/examples/{config}/{name}.json"
                if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_mtime_ns < cutoff:
                    ready = False
                    break
                try:
                    json.loads(path.read_text())
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    ready = False
                    break
    if ready:
        command = [sys.executable, "scripts/compare_backends.py", "artifacts/examples/cpu",
                   *(f"artifacts/examples/{config}" for config in configs)]
        with (out / "backend-comparison.json").open("w") as stdout, (out / "backend-comparison-errors.log").open("w") as stderr:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
        (out / "comparison-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({"command": command, "exit_code": result.returncode}, indent=2) + "\n")
        print(f"Final comparison exit code: {result.returncode}", flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
    time.sleep(5)
raise SystemExit("timed out waiting for complete fresh configurations")

"""Capture the completed local qualification; never edits historical records."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import tarfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out = root / "artifacts/photonic-completion"

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def passed(path):
    text = path.read_text()
    assert "test result: FAILED" not in text, path
    matches = re.findall(r"test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored", text)
    assert matches and all(int(f) == int(i) == 0 for _, f, i in matches), path
    return {"passed": sum(int(n) for n, _, _ in matches), "targets": len(matches)}

catalog = sorted(p.stem for p in (root / "crates/burn_quantum_example/src/bin").glob("*.rs"))
runtime = sorted(p.stem for p in (root / "crates/burn_quantum/tests").glob("*.rs")
                 if "support/device.rs" in p.read_text())
configs = ("cpu", "wgpu", "wgpu-fusion", "cuda", "cuda-fusion")
reports = {}
matrix = {}
latest_rust_source_ns = max(p.stat().st_mtime_ns for p in (root / "crates").rglob("*.rs"))
report_files = {}
for config in configs:
    reports[config] = {}
    for name in catalog:
        path = root / f"artifacts/examples/{config}/{name}.json"
        assert path.stat().st_mtime_ns >= latest_rust_source_ns, ("stale report predates final Rust source", path)
        report = json.loads(path.read_text())
        assert report["example"] == name
        assert report["backend"] == config.removesuffix("-fusion")
        assert report["fusion"] == config.endswith("-fusion")
        reports[config][name] = report
        report_files[str(path.relative_to(root))] = {"sha256": sha(path), "modified_unix_ns": path.stat().st_mtime_ns}
    if config == "cpu":
        matrix[config] = {"workspace": passed(out / "cpu-final.log"),
                          "doctests": passed(out / "doctests.log")}
    else:
        directory = root / f"artifacts/validation/{config}"
        core = out / "core-final" / f"{config}.log"
        examples = directory / "example-tests.log"
        for name in runtime:
            assert f"Running tests/{name}.rs" in core.read_text(), (config, name)
        for name in catalog:
            assert f"Running unittests src/bin/{name}.rs" in examples.read_text(), (config, name)
        matrix[config] = {"runtime_core": passed(core), "example_tests": passed(examples),
                          "mps_examples_revalidated_after_layout_fix": passed(out / "core-final" / f"{config}-mps-examples.log")}
        assert json.loads((out / "core-final" / f"{config}-status.json").read_text())["exit_code"] == 0
        if config == "cuda-fusion":
            assert json.loads((out / "cuda-fusion-final-status.json").read_text())["exit_code"] == 0
        else:
            assert json.loads((out / f"{config}-status.json").read_text())[config]["exit_code"] == 0
    matrix[config]["example_reports"] = len(catalog)

source_paths = [root / "Cargo.toml", root / "Cargo.lock", root / "rust-toolchain.toml"]
source_paths += list((root / ".github/workflows").glob("*.yml"))
for directory in (root / "crates", root / "scripts"):
    source_paths += [p for p in directory.rglob("*") if p.is_file()
                     and "__pycache__" not in p.parts and not p.name.endswith(".pyc")]
sources = {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha(p) for p in sorted(set(source_paths))}
digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sources, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()

archive = root / "target/package/burn_quantum-0.2.0.crate"
with tarfile.open(archive) as package:
    members = {m.name.removeprefix("burn_quantum-0.2.0/"): m for m in package.getmembers() if m.isfile()}
    matched = []
    for relative, member in members.items():
        if relative in ("Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock", ".cargo_vcs_info.json", "Cargo.toml.orig"):
            continue
        current = root / "crates/burn_quantum" / relative
        assert current.is_file(), relative
        assert current.read_bytes() == package.extractfile(member).read(), relative
        matched.append(relative)
    vcs = json.loads(package.extractfile(members[".cargo_vcs_info.json"]).read())
    assert vcs["path_in_vcs"] == "crates/burn_quantum"
    assert package.extractfile(members["Cargo.toml.orig"]).read() == (root / "crates/burn_quantum/Cargo.toml").read_bytes()

log_paths = list(out.glob("*.log")) + list((out / "core-final").glob("*.log"))
for config in configs[1:]:
    log_paths += list((root / f"artifacts/validation/{config}").glob("*.log"))
logs = {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha(p) for p in sorted(set(log_paths))}
harness_names = ("qualify-cpu-final.sh", "qualify-gpu-final.sh", "qualify-gpu-core-final.sh", "compare-final.py", "record.py")
harness = {str((out / name).relative_to(root)): {"sha256": sha(out / name), "content": (out / name).read_text()}
           for name in harness_names}
statuses = {str(p.relative_to(root)): json.loads(p.read_text())
            for p in sorted(out.rglob("*-status.json"))}
assert json.loads((out / "comparison-status.json").read_text())["exit_code"] == 0
gpu_commands = {}
for config in configs[1:]:
    backend = config.removesuffix("-fusion")
    features = f"--features {backend}" + (" --features fusion" if config.endswith("-fusion") else "")
    selection = backend + (" --fusion" if config.endswith("-fusion") else "")
    gpu_commands[config] = {
        "environment": {"BURN_QUANTUM_DEVICE": backend, "CARGO_NET_OFFLINE": "true"},
        "initial_pipeline": f"bash scripts/validate_backend.sh {selection}",
        "final_core": f"cargo test --locked -p burn_quantum {features} " + " ".join(f"--test {name}" for name in runtime) + " -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture",
        "mps_example_revalidation": f"cargo test --locked -p burn_quantum_example {features} --bin mps_qaoa --bin distributed_mps -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture",
        "example_tests": f"cargo test --locked -p burn_quantum_example {features} --bins -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture",
        "example_reports": f"bash scripts/run_examples.sh {selection}",
        "core_examples": [f"cargo run --locked -p burn_quantum {features} --example {name}" for name in ("bell", "qudit", "train", "hybrid", "profile")],
    }
record = {
    "date": "2026-11-09", "base_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
    "working_tree": "uncommitted and unreleased", "package_version": "0.2.0", "rust": "1.95.0", "burn": "0.22.1",
    "hardware": json.loads((out / "hardware.json").read_text()),
    "source_digest_algorithm": "sha256 of sorted compact JSON mapping repository-relative source paths to sha256",
    "source_sha256": digest, "source_files": sources,
    "qualification_harness": harness, "qualification_statuses": statuses,
    "gpu_commands": gpu_commands,
    "comparison_command": "python3 scripts/compare_backends.py artifacts/examples/cpu artifacts/examples/wgpu artifacts/examples/wgpu-fusion artifacts/examples/cuda artifacts/examples/cuda-fusion",
    "report_freshness": {"latest_rust_source_modified_unix_ns": latest_rust_source_ns,
                         "rule": "Every final report is newer than every final Rust source, and its configuration pipeline completed successfully; this is local execution provenance, not cryptographic binary attestation.",
                         "files": report_files},
    "matrix": matrix, "runtime_targets": runtime, "example_binaries": catalog,
    "checks": json.loads((out / "check-status.json").read_text()),
    "package": {"sha256": sha(archive), "file_count": len(members), "byte_identical_files": len(matched), "original_manifest_identical": True, "vcs": vcs},
    "log_sha256": logs,
    "backend_comparison": json.loads((out / "backend-comparison.json").read_text()),
    "example_reports": reports,
    "independent_fixtures": {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha(p) for p in sorted((root / "crates/burn_quantum/tests").rglob("*.json"))},
    "fixture_versions": {
        "perceval": {k: json.loads((root / "crates/burn_quantum/tests/optics_perceval_v1_3.json").read_text())[k]
                     for k in ("perceval", "exqalibur", "numpy", "backend")},
        "stim": "1.15.0",
        "psiqdk": json.loads((root / "crates/burn_quantum/tests/interop/psiqdk-2.5.0.json").read_text())["packages"],
    },

    },

finite_shot_fit_diagnostic.comparison_contract: Only the fitted phase-error diagnostic uses its existing independent nonnegative <0.05 acceptance bound. Both values and their difference are retained; physics, held-out quality and physical-cost checks are unchanged.

qualification_scope: M0-M7 bounded local reference implementations; acceptance map in docs/photonic-status.md.

Every GPU core target was rerun after the MPS layout fix; the two MPS example binaries were separately revalidated in all four configurations. Other example test implementations were unchanged, and final reports execute after the fix.
Routing, tableaux, Pauli frames, decoding, control and complex MPS SVD remain explicit host operations.
Actual local PsiQDK 2.5.0 simulator fixtures; no provider credentials or hardware execution.
One entangled MPS distributed across actual loopback worker processes; no multi-host throughput claim.
Finite six-ring logical correlations, planar-code circuits and magic protocols have separate explicit noise assumptions; no production fault-tolerant fabric or threshold claim.
